pages.useful_because: The homepage is the only page that lays out every AP Remodeling Handyman List trade side by side (the full handyman list from drywall and TV mounting to deck and fence repair, bathroom and kitchen remodeling, flooring, siding and windows, roofing) with the company's own job photos captioned by what they show: a walk-in shower in large-format marble-look tile with recessed niches, a hex mosaic bathroom floor, drywall patched around new tile, a sloped-ceiling bedroom painted with new baseboard over bare subfloor, and an arched window return finished for paint. It names the owner (Charles Poe), the 32 years in business, the seven-day 9-to-6 hours, the weekday estimate-visit windows and all eleven Indiana and Michigan towns served, and it explains why a failed caulk line or loose tile is worth fixing before water reaches the drywall and subfloor.
